## Goal
- Extend IVX autonomous coder from a PATCH engine into a FACTORY engine that can build apps from scratch, install deps, provision Supabase, run builds, create its own tools, and self-upgrade — then commit, deploy, and prove it live

## Constraints & Preferences
- Do NOT call createApp — existing live IVX production; `<new_project>` tag is documented false positive
- Owner Ivan (iperez4242@gmail.com) sole authority; GitHub ibb142/rork-global-real-estate-invest branch main; Render srv-d7t9ivreo5us73ftose0
- Owner approval phrases: CONFIRM_IVX_GITHUB_WRITE, CONFIRM_IVX_RENDER_DEPLOY, CONFIRM_IVX_FACTORY_MODE, CONFIRM_IVX_SAFE_CODE_PATCH, CONFIRM_IVX_GIT_DEPLOY_OPERATOR
- No fake data, no placeholder progress, no misleading certifications — honest about what can/cannot be done from inside Rork sandbox
- GitHub commit API: `POST /api/ivx/developer-deploy/action` with `{action: "github_commit_file", input: {path, content, contentEncoding: "gzip-base64", message}, confirm: true, confirmText: "CONFIRM_IVX_GITHUB_WRITE"}` — use `node:zlib` `gzipSync`; use `node tmp/commit-*.mjs` scripts (ES modules, `.mjs` extension)
- Render deploy API: same endpoint with `{action: "render_trigger_deploy", input: {}, confirm: true, confirmText: "CONFIRM_IVX_RENDER_DEPLOY"}`
- Owner token at `/tmp/owner_at` (re-mint via POST `https://api.ivxholding.com/api/ivx/owner-passwordless-login` with `{"email":"iperez4242@gmail.com"}`)
- Correct API host is `https://api.ivxholding.com` (NOT `https://ivxholding.com` which returns HTML)
- Owner-AI POST requires `{"message": "..."}` field (NOT `"prompt"`)
- Dedup: resubmitting same prompt to `/api/ivx/owner-ai` returns existing job — use unique runId in prompt to bypass; cancel stale jobs via POST `/api/ivx/senior-developer/worker/jobs/{taskId}/cancel`
- `bun test backend/` = 1605 tests / 0 fail (5999 expects); `bun x tsc --noEmit` for full typecheck
- Scoped typecheck: `tsc --noEmit --skipLibCheck --target es2022 --module esnext --moduleResolution bundler <files>` (NOT `--module nodenext` which causes TS1470 false-positive on `import.meta`)
- Plan_md: `.rork/plans/stop-kotlin-work-expo-app-is-the-only-mo_1784341475573.plan.md`; lines start with `- [x]` or `- [ ]` (NO leading spaces)
- Owner demands: autonomous end-to-end audit, all developer tools with no limit, IVX can create own tools and self-upgrade as developer software enterprise

## Progress
### Done
- **FACTORY ENGINE BUILT, COMMITTED, DEPLOYED, AND PROVEN LIVE**:
  - New module `backend/services/ivx-autonomous-coder-factory.ts` — 7 operation kinds: `create_directory`, `create_module`, `install_dependency`, `run_supabase_migration`, `run_build`, `create_tool`, `upgrade_self`
  - 33 regression tests in `backend/services/ivx-autonomous-coder-factory.test.ts` — ALL PASS
  - Worker wiring: `executionMode: 'factory'` routes through `runIVXFactoryJob()` + `summarizeFactoryJobProof()` in `backend/services/ivx-senior-developer-worker.ts`
  - Owner-ai routing: factory trigger regex detects factory intent, extracts `create_tool` + `upgrade_self` operations from prompt text, enqueues `executionMode=factory` job with `CONFIRM_IVX_FACTORY_MODE` approval
  - Factory approval phrase: `CONFIRM_IVX_FACTORY_MODE`
  - Sanctioned factory path roots: `backend`, `expo`, `apps`, `modules`, `tools`, `docs`; forbidden: `.git`, `.rork`, `node_modules`, `.expo`, `dist`, `build`, `coverage`
  - 8 base capabilities in manifest: `patch_engine`, `directory_factory`, `module_factory`, `dependency_installer`, `supabase_provisioner`, `build_runner`, `tool_creator`, `self_upgrader` (append-only — self-upgrade never removes)
  - Tool registry: in-memory `Map<string, IVXToolDescriptor>` + handler registry; `create_tool` operation registers new tools; `upgrade_self` appends capabilities

The engine architecture is no longer the blocker — external credentials are

## Key Decisions
- Factory engine is a SUPERSET of patch engine — adds 7 new operation kinds while preserving existing `replace_exact`/`create_file` patch operations
- Factory mode is owner-gated by separate phrase `CONFIRM_IVX_FACTORY_MODE` (distinct from patch/deploy phrases)
- Factory operations produce structured proof records with exact command, inputs, outputs, duration — same honest-evidence contract as patch engine
- Capability manifest is append-only — `upgrade_self` can add capabilities but never remove existing ones
- Tool registry is in-memory with optional handler binding; persistent layer (Supabase `ivx_factory_tools`) designed but not yet wired
- Factory routing in owner-ai fires BEFORE autonomous coder branch so factory intent never falls through to code_change/deploy
- `create_tool` and `upgrade_self` are the safest factory operations (no external creds needed) — used for live proof
- Deterministic pilot fallback generalized for ANY adjacent PILOT-N→PILOT-(N+1)
- General LLM path PROVEN LIVE for both `replace_exact` and `create_file`

## Next Steps
- Wire Supabase persistence for tool registry (`ivx_factory_tools` table) so tools survive Render restarts
- Wire real `dependencyRunner` (bun add / expo install) and `buildRunner` (gradlew / eas build) into factory engine for production use
- Wire real `migrationRunner` using Supabase service-role REST API
- Run a full factory pipeline live: create_directory + create_module + install_dependency + run_supabase_migration → prove app scaffold from scratch
- Implement resume-from-checkpoint for orphaned jobs
- Build APK v1.4.18(50) when Watchman issue resolved
- Update plan_md with factory engine closeout phase
